# The surcharge is not another tax rate.

> Work your IFTA quarterly return from your own trip and fuel records: average fleet MPG, taxable gallons and net taxable gallons per jurisdiction, the Indiana/Kentucky/Virginia surcharge charged the way it is actually charged, and interest on a late return. Free, private, nothing leaves your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
